title: Context, Compaction & Handoff Chain
brief: Align PreCompact/PostCompact/SessionEnd/boot recovery into a unified context management chain. Chain-state serialization for persistence across compactions. Context-trim rules by bundle type. Handoff package generation for session transitions. Recovery quality scoring.

units.title: Align PreCompact/PostCompact/SessionEnd hooks into unified context chain with shared state contract
Implement chain-state serialization: persist active chain progress, pending steps, and intermediate results across compactions
Define context-trim rules by bundle type: code bundles keep file paths + diffs, product bundles keep parameters + results
Implement handoff package generation: serialize current task state, progress, and next-steps for session transitions
Implement recovery quality scoring: measure fact survival rate post-compaction, flag sessions with >20% context loss

exit_conditions: PreCompact/PostCompact/SessionEnd aligned into single context chain
Chain state survives compaction via serialization
Context-trim rules applied per bundle type
Handoff packages generated for all session transitions
Recovery quality scored with actionable thresholds
